Package com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.login

Class BffLoginController

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.authserver.bff.api.web.login.BffLoginController
All Implemented Interfaces:
LoginApi
@RestController public class BffLoginController extends Object implements LoginApi
Starts the OpenID Connect login, as the contract apis/bff/rest-server/bff-api-v1.yaml describes it through the generated LoginApi.

  • Method Details

    • login

      public org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity<Void> login(String returnTo, String acrValues, Long maxAge)
      Validates returnTo, keeps it in the session for ReturnToAuthenticationSuccessHandler, which sends the browser there once the OAuth2 login succeeds, keeps the step-up values (if any) for StepUpAuthorizationRequestResolver, which adds them to the authorization request, and redirects to the authorization request. The format and range of acrValues and maxAge are checked by the generated interface.
      Specified by:
      login in interface LoginApi
      Parameters:
      returnTo - relative path to return to after the login; the root of the application when absent.
      acrValues - authentication context classes to ask the authorization server for; none when absent.
      maxAge - maximum age, in seconds, of the authentication to ask for; none when absent.
      Returns:
      a redirect to the authorization request.
      Throws:
      org.springframework.web.server.ResponseStatusException - answered 400 when returnTo is not an allowed relative path.
